title: Buruh mengaku salah simbah cecair busuk di masjid, ambil dadah
summary: PASIR MAS - Seorang buruh kasar mengaku bersalah di Mahkamah Majistret di sini pada Khamis atas pertuduhan melakukan khianat dengan menyimbah cecair berbau busuk pada karpet sebuah masjid di Tumpat.Tertuduh, Manjesh Singh Shukdev Singh, 38, turut mengaku bersalah atas pertuduhan mengambil dadah.ARTI

title_en: Worker confesses to giving dirty liquid in mosque, taking drugs
summary_en: PASIR MAS - A labourer pleaded guilty in the Magistrate Court here on Thursday to charges of treason by sprinkling a foul-smelling liquid onto carpets at a mosque in Tumpat. The defendant, Manjesh Singh Shukdev Singh, 38, also pleaded guilt for taking drugs.
